root_cause_discovery.finding: Root cause of build-time database access: src/app/layout.tsx imported @/lib/db-init at root level, triggering database initialization for all pages during build
root_cause_discovery.problematic_import: import '@/lib/db-init'; // Ensure database is initialized on server startup
root_cause_discovery.mechanism: When Next.js builds the app, it imports the root layout which imports db-init, which tries to initialize Prisma client and connect to the database. This happens at build time before force-dynamic pages are evaluated.
root_cause_discovery.why_force_dynamic_pages_alone_didnt_work: force-dynamic pages prevent their own pre-rendering, but the root layout is still pre-compiled, and db-init is imported unconditionally regardless of page dynamism.

files_with_force_dynamic_added.reason_added: Root index page calls getSession() and redirects based on auth state - requires runtime auth context
files_with_force_dynamic_added.build_time_evidence: Page was trying to authenticate at build time, failing when no session context available

files_with_force_dynamic_added.reason_added: Page calls getSession() and requireWorkspaceContext() - requires runtime auth and workspace validation
files_with_force_dynamic_added.build_time_evidence: Page tried to verify user authentication and workspace access at build time without user context

files_with_force_dynamic_added.reason_added: Page calls getSession(), database queries, and workspace enforcement - requires runtime auth and DB access
files_with_force_dynamic_added.build_time_evidence: generateMetadata and page component both query database for decision details based on route params and auth context

files_with_force_dynamic_added.reason_added: Already had force-dynamic - layout calls getSession() for all authenticated routes
files_with_force_dynamic_added.build_time_evidence: Layout wraps all authenticated routes and enforces authentication

actual_fix_applied.rationale: Database initialization on server startup is not needed at build time. Database will initialize naturally on first runtime request that needs it. Vitest setup already initializes database for tests.
actual_fix_applied.impact: Eliminates build-time database access attempt that was causing npm run build to fail
actual_fix_applied.preference_over_force_dynamic_root: Adding force-dynamic to root layout is not appropriate - root layout is static and should be pre-rendered. Removing db-init import is the correct architectural fix.
